title: Crayola Fun Effects Mini Twistables Crayons, 24-Count, 1 Pack

reviews.title: Great Crayons, Torn Packaging
reviews.body: Love these twistable crayons, but disappointed that of 3 purchases I made, this item came in torn boxes twice, and once there was even a broken crayon. Not sure why this item always comes looking so old and with worn packaging. If it’s for own use, probably no issue - my boys and I love using them. But as gifts, you might just want to purchase them from stores so you can choose those with better packaging:)
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Colores originales.
reviews.body: Vienen en una caja de plástico,separados en tres alturas,tal y como se ve en la foto de presentación.Tiene algunos colores diferentes a las cajas de pinturas de toda la vida y otros lápices donde se mezclan los colores para pintar de forma diferente en una sola traZada.Son más blandos que unas plastidecor tradicional,pero de tamaño parecido.Evidentemente,si el niño aprieta mucho se pueden romper,pero no más que las de otro tipo o marca.Creo que ha sido una buena compra.
reviews.author: Cliente Amazon

reviews.title: Mess free colouring
reviews.body: Been used by a wide range of kids ages. Great for packing in a bag and not as messy as felt tips and no need for sharpening like pencils. So a great alternative colouring tools.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 21 January 2026
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Crayola 24 Mini Twistable
reviews.body: Wir haben mit den Stiften tolle Sachen gemalt. Den Kindern wie auch den Erwachsenen gefallen die Bilder sehr . Man kann schöne Effekte malen und es macht allen super viel Spaß.Corina 16.09.2013
reviews.author: Corina

reviews.title: The kids love them - but so much plastic
reviews.body: One time I looked up whether Crayola was considering making twistables reusable. I found a bunch of other people were asking them for the same thing. The official comment was that they weren't considering it at the moment. I would LOVE these if they were reusable. It would be so easy to achieve!
reviews.author: Jane Doe

NO SHARPENING REQUIRED: This exclusive drawing set never needs sharpening or peeling.
